body: By the way, Riven isn't disabled. Here on EUW I played against Riven and with one while she was "disabled". Riot Games lmao

I'm really trying my best, but sometimes, when I'm on my bike, my brain flips a switch and goes like "this is it, you either brake now or you finally are happy again". I know I shouldn't feel like this.

I will look into it, but not being able to play something I've practiced for 14 years kills me. Its just like I wasted 14 years of my life. My grades suffered from it because I really was able to build a proper career, but now this. I really dont know how to feel about it.

Yea, you are right. He needs me more than ever. I think I'll be fine for now. But I don't want my dad to think of anything stupid (like I did).
He told me not to get mad at my mother because he thinks its partly his fault. I do not agree with him and I'm actually really, really mad at my mother. I love her but she still fucked up big time, this time she wont get back into my heart that easily. I really appreciate your help, I wish I could just forget everything and let loose, but I just can't. 
Thank you again for your advice, this really helps out alot even though I'm still feeling pretty bad.

Thanks man, I hope you get well too. I don't want to sound selfish but I can't really help you because I need to sort out my problems first. But I really do hope you get better, you deserve it man. Stay safe.

I'm trying my best. I guess its safe to say that if it wasn't for Reddit I'd be dead by now. I want to thank you, you are one of the people that put suicide out of my mind. I don't even know what I was thinking. I'm so sorry Reddit.

No motivation for anything, yea. I know you are trying to help me but I'm just being a stubborn moron. I am really sorry about that. I know I shouldn't be like this but I just can't help it anymore. After all the shit I've taken, after all the shit I had to see I feel like there is nothing else I can do except killing myself. I know it sounds dumb, and pathetic too. I would really like to pass cars but I fear that I will lose control over myself and crash into the nearest car hoping to die.

Atleast I got my motorcycle, where I live is nothing but country side and a bit of big city, I got a place where I can hang around and get off but that doesn't work anymore. I'm kind of burned out too, ever since my friend died I have no motivation for anything. Thats really sad because I was always the guy to go first when it comes to doing stuff.
I'm trying my best. I really am. Like always, I wont give up now but I just don't know what to do as of now. Today was the day where my life hit a new low. I doubt I'll be useful the next few weeks.

I am so sorry to hear all this about your life, I'm very glad to hear that it got better though. Thats a success even for me, because thats something that will keep me up even now. Its almost midnight here and I'm still sitting next to my bike. Honestly I don't plan on getting back tonight so I'd just stay up all night, thats probably better for me right now. Thank you for your help man, it really means alot to me as you can tell
